resources.string: The app list is empty right now.
Phone, emergency calling, your Home screen and Settings are not listed. Rules never block them.
During the window, Sleep targets apps outside your allowed list. Known safety apps are excluded.
Each night starts on the selected evening. No nights selected means every night.
24-hour time. A window can continue past midnight.
Selects Easy as the starting tier. You can choose a different tier below.
Selects Harder as the starting tier. You can choose a different tier below.
Blocking only. Flint includes no soundscapes or meditations.
Turning Sleep off requires confirmation. Active Easy Sleep occurrences end after you confirm.
During an active Harder Sleep occurrence, turning Sleep off requires a wait and final confirmation. Outside an active occurrence, no wait is required.
During an active Hardcore Sleep occurrence, turning Sleep off is saved for after that occurrence ends. Outside an active occurrence, you can turn Sleep off after confirmation.
No extra apps allowed. Known safety apps are excluded from Sleep rules.
The same allowed apps apply from wake time until the morning end.
Not set up. Bedtime blocking with an optional morning window.
Bedtime, wake and morning end must be times between 00:00 and 23:59.
Bedtime and wake time cannot be the same.
Morning assist must end after the wake time.
